stem:
Use “Life on Mars” and “Say Yes to Exploring Mars” to answer the following question.

Which idea is presented in BOTH selections “Life on Mars” and “Say Yes to Exploring Mars”?

options.label: A
options.text: Space travel allows inventors to develop inventions that people can use on Earth.

options.label: B
options.text: Humans have a natural desire to study the land that surrounds them.

options.label: C
options.text: Humans would be able to gather valuable information by traveling to Mars.

options.label: D
options.text: Scientists now know enough about Mars to disprove the ideas of early astronomers.
